Message:
Ever since that day,
my little brother stayed healthy.
Our life had improved,
and I only have God
to thank for that.

By simply wishing,
I could attain as many jewels
as I wanted...

Enough to afford all
the medicine and nutrition
we could ever want.

We could finally live in riches.
And so, day after day,
I used my power.

Until one day...
when my brother looked at me
with sadness in his eyes,
and said...

“Why did you throw away
the scarf I made for you?”

He made a scarf...?
What’s he talking about?
I’d definitely cherish
something like that,
and I...

Did using my power...
make me lose
such an important memory?

What should I do...?
If I keep this up,
even the memories
with my brother
might one day...

“I’m sorry!
I know I’ve changed,
but from now on,
Big Sis is back!”

I held tightly
onto my anxious brother.
I couldn’t lose him.
They can take these jewels,
these riches—just not him!

We might go back
to being poor,
but I’m sure things will
turn out for the better.

Because, as long as
I have my little brother,
I don’t need anything else.
